# Current Windows preview

Source `d2031d5e` is available as a portable ZIP, an NSIS installer and
unsigned development MSIX 29.

Native checks covered the portable keyboard picker, NSIS upgrade and locked
cache recovery, Borders controls, Search status and DOCX Inspector. MSIX 29
passed fresh deployment and enabled and disabled upgrades from revision 28.
Explorer folder actions remain available. Windows keeps the current default
folder app when Ottrin is installed through MSIX.

See ../WINDOWS_CANDIDATE_ACCEPTANCE.json for scope and artifact hashes.
